```yaml
name: E2E Windows

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  e2e-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: '**/go.sum'

      - name: Install mise
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          iwr -useb https://mise.jdx.dev/install.ps1 | iex
          echo "$env:USERPROFILE\.local\share\mise\shims" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          mise install
          mise run fmt
          mise run lint

      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: mise run test:ci
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Slack notification on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1
        with:
          payload: |
            {
              "text": "E2E Windows tests failed on ${{ github.repository }}",
              "attachments": [
                {
                  "title": "Workflow: ${{ github.workflow }}",
                  "title_link": "${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}",
                  "color": "#FF0000"
                }
              ]
            }
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
```
